explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at every D2 step after choosing a1. It turns on only at D2 after choosing a2 in the last trials of the episode: about 0 before trial ~80, about 3-4 around trials 84-88, about 6 around trial 94 (1 if a1 was chosen the trial before), and 8-10 for trials 92-99 when a2 has been chosen several trials in a row, regardless of rewards or whether the transition was common or rare.
